data.notes: January 2027’s confirmed calendar is still sparse, but it already has a notable psych/alt festival play plus arena-scale classic rock, pop, and international metal/rock tours.

events.title: Rush – Fifty Something Tour
events.summary: Rush’s official tour page confirms the Fifty Something Tour date at Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires on January 15, 2027.

events.title: Levitation Argentina 2027
events.summary: Levitation’s first Argentina edition is confirmed for January 20, 2027 in Buenos Aires, with Melvins, Osees, Boris, Frankie and the Witch Fingers, and Winona Riders announced on the bill.

events.title: Freya Skye – Stars Align Tour
events.summary: Freya Skye’s official tour page lists a Buenos Aires date at C Art Media on January 25, 2027 as part of her 2027 international tour routing.

events.title: Oostil x Bob Tosh x Temple Gate x Mushroom NYE
events.summary: Mushroom’s post-NYE melodic-techno event in Ezeiza, with Oostil, Bob Tosh and Temple Gate listed for 02:00 on January 1.

events.title: Avatar at Teatro Flores
events.summary: Swedish metal band Avatar plays Teatro Flores, with the event page listing Wednesday, January 13, 2027 at 19:00.

events.title: Geoff Tate’s Operation: Mindcrime – The Final Chapter
events.summary: Geoff Tate brings his Operation: Mindcrime – The Final Chapter show to Vorterix in Buenos Aires on January 14, 2027 at 19:00, according to his official tour page.

events.title: Crashdïet – South America Tour 2027
events.summary: Crashdïet’s Buenos Aires stop on the South America Tour 2027 is confirmed at El Teatrito for Friday, January 29, 2027 at 18:00.
